output.rule: Use 只要……就 for an “as long as” condition, and use Subj. + 就 + V. to show the natural result; for an action that happens at an early age/number, use 才 Num.就V. Do not use 会 for this result, because 会 means “will” for the future.
output.explanation_template: <wrong> → <correct>: <meaning/condition> leads naturally to <result>, so use 只要……就 or put the subject before 就 (Subj. + 就 + V.).

examples.explanation: 他有的时候只要跟朋友玩儿 → 他只要跟朋友玩儿: use 只要 for an “as long as” condition, not 有的时候 (“sometimes”).
可是孟子的妈妈有别的看法 → 可是孟子的妈妈就抱怨: the condition leads to the result, so use 就抱怨.
他一吃灵芝，就身体好了 → 他一吃灵芝，身体就好了: put the subject before 就 (Subj. + 就).
孟子才三岁开始搬家 → 孟子才三岁就开始搬家: at only age three, the action already starts, so use 才 Num.就V.
会生病了 → 就生病了: this is the result of the condition, so use 就; 会 means “will” for the future.

output.not_an_error: When you mean “sometimes,” use 有的时候, not 只要……就. 会 is appropriate when you mean “will” in the future.
